Sleek Wireless Charger and Table Lamp – Smart Lighting & Fast Charging in One Device

Upgrade your workspace, bedroom, or study area with the Sleek Wireless Charger and Table Lamp, a modern multifunctional solution designed for convenience, style, and performance. This innovative device seamlessly combines 10W wireless charging, a premium LED table lamp, and dual USB charging slots, making it an ideal choice for homes, offices, hotels, and corporate gifting.

Built for today’s fast-paced lifestyle, this smart lamp offers 3 color mode light, adjustable brightness, and a compact, space-saving design. Whether you need focused lighting for work or ambient light for relaxation, this lamp adapts effortlessly while keeping your devices powered and organized.

Fast & Safe 10W Wireless Charging

The integrated 10W wireless charging pad supports quick and efficient power delivery for all Qi-enabled smartphones. Simply place your phone on the charging surface and enjoy cable-free convenience. With advanced safety protection against overcharging, overheating, and short circuits, your devices remain secure during every charge.

Multiple Charging Options with 5V/3A Output

In addition to wireless charging, this lamp features a powerful 5V/3A output and 2 USB charging slots, allowing you to charge multiple devices at the same time. Power your smartphone, smartwatch, earbuds, or power bank effortlessly from one compact unit, reducing clutter on your desk or bedside table.

Customizable Lighting with 3 Color Modes

Experience personalized lighting with 3 color mode light options – warm white, natural white, and cool white. The adjustable brightness feature allows you to fine-tune illumination levels based on your needs, making it suitable for reading, studying, working, or nighttime use.

The lamp operates at just 4 Watts, ensuring energy efficiency without compromising brightness. Its flicker-free LED technology helps reduce eye strain, making it perfect for long hours of use.

Modern Design for Home & Office

The Sleek Wireless Charger and Table Lamp features a minimalist and contemporary design that complements modern interiors. Its slim profile fits easily on desks, side tables, and nightstands, enhancing aesthetics while maximizing functionality. This all-in-one wireless charging lamp is ideal for professionals, students, and tech-savvy users.

Ideal for Corporate Gifting & Promotional Use

This multifunctional table lamp is a popular choice for corporate gifts, promotional giveaways, and branded merchandise. With ample branding space, it can be customized with your company logo, making it a practical and premium gifting solution for employees, clients, and events.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Sleek Wireless Charger and Table Lamp with modern design
  • 10W wireless charging for Qi-enabled devices
  • 3 color mode light – warm, natural, and cool white
  • Adjustable brightness for personalized lighting
  • 5V/3A output for fast and stable power delivery
  • 2 USB charging slots for multiple devices
  • Energy-efficient LED with 4 Watts power consumption
  • Ideal for home, office, hotels, and corporate gifting

Why Choose This Wireless Charging Table Lamp?

By combining lighting and charging into one intelligent device, this lamp helps declutter your space while improving productivity and comfort. The combination of wireless charger table lamp, USB charging hub, and adjustable LED lighting makes it a versatile and future-ready solution for modern living.
